OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH & SAFETY
The safety of our employees, contractors,
customers, and the public is our topmost priority
in whatever we do. Given the risks related to
electricity, the expansive nature of the distribution
network, and the magnitude of operations, we
acknowledge the underlying safety risks.
While guided by regulatory requirements, our safety
plans and actions aim to achieve higher results. We
will not undertake any activity without proper safety
procedures, equipment and training being in place.
